en.heading: Shape the translation experience around you.
en.intro: Audio, captions, recording, and synchronized playback live in one calm, readable space—leaving the popup focused on starting quickly.
en.connectionHelp: Keys stay in this browser session by default. Remembering them on this device is optional.
en.keyReady: The key is ready for this session.
en.keyCleared: The key was removed from this session and device.
en.outputHelp: All four channels are independent—combine them however you like.
en.pageOutputHelp: These controls affect only the fast “On this page” mode.
en.syncOutputHelp: Independent from on-page playback; this audio mix is also used for the exported video.
en.originalAudioHelp: The page or video’s real sound
en.autoDuckHelp: Lower the original while translated speech plays.
en.recordingHelp: Two WAV and two SRT files in Downloads; off by default.
en.downloadsDenied: Output saving stays off without Downloads access.
en.captionsHelp: Move, resize, and scroll the card directly on the page.
en.syncHelp: The tab keeps recording ahead of playback so seeking and dubbing remain stable.
en.bufferHelp: Capture stays ahead of playback; 20 seconds is recommended for stability.
en.whisperTiming: Whisper + LLM + Gemini 3.1 Live · more precise
en.timingEngineHelp: Precise mode timestamps each utterance with Groq Whisper, translates it through the free Gemini model pool, then fits Gemini 3.1 Flash Live speech to that exact interval. On restricted networks, Chrome must also route api.groq.com through the browser or system proxy.
en.groqKeyReady: The Groq key is ready for this session.
en.groqKeyMissing: Add a Groq key to use precise mode.
en.groqPermissionReady: Chrome access to Groq is enabled.
en.groqPermissionMissing: Chrome access to Groq has not been granted yet.
en.groqConsentTitle: I allow short audio windows from the selected tab to be sent directly to Groq Whisper
en.groqConsentBody: This happens only in precise mode to transcribe speech and return timestamps. The resulting text then goes to Google Gemini for translation and voice generation.
en.consentTipBody: Before the first translation, open Privacy below and confirm that audio from the selected tab may be sent to Google Gemini.
en.privacyHelp: Avorythm has no ads, analytics, or developer-operated server.
en.consentTitle: I allow audio from my selected tab to be sent to Google Gemini
en.consentBody: Processing starts only after you press Start. Four-output saving is off by default; synchronized playback records the tab locally for seeking and WebM export.
en.groqPermissionDenied: Whisper timing needs permission to connect to Groq.
